notes.title: Hades' Star 2025.1 is now available!
notes.content:
This major update focuses on changes requested by the community. To vote on future update features, join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/hadesstar

Detailed changelog: 

[list]
[*]Named Ship Loadouts allow saving module configurations and quickly refitting other ships, or constructing new identical ships. Access from the Module Installation page. (https://discord.com/channels/255083954036670464/1206751668344197191/threads/1274969769434419201)
[*]Leap and Dispatch now show visual indicator for the AOE damage radius at the landing site (https://discord.com/channels/255083954036670464/1206751668344197191/threads/1316265870846201888)
[*]A cancelled Dark Red Star search no longer resets the daily rich artifact timer (https://discord.com/channels/255083954036670464/1197268069370835114/threads/1298728480250396732)
[*]Flagship modules now persist their cooldowns across jumps, same as all other regular ship modules (https://discord.com/channels/255083954036670464/1197268069370835114/threads/1227370049388417064)
[*]Blast Drone now persists number of activations remaining between jumps to the White Star
[*]Fixed issue that could cause scheduled orders to link to/from a Chain Ray Drone weapon to fail to execute (https://discord.com/channels/255083954036670464/1197268069370835114/threads/1197492350222610462)
[*] Artifacts or Relics that are in the process of loading on the Transport ship will now always return to the planet if the Transport ship is destroyed, regardless of star type. This also fixes a bug where the Time Machine would show incorrect information when such a Transport is destroyed. (https://discord.com/channels/255083954036670464/1197268069370835114/threads/1206543942640865330)
[*] Remote Mining will now restart after using Artifact Boost (https://discord.com/channels/255083954036670464/1197268069370835114/threads/1288975052657791087)
[*] Fixed wrong background scaling in module buttons that have reduced width (https://discord.com/channels/255083954036670464/1326424577600917514)
[*] Corporation officers can now add a Discord webhook on the Corporation's settings, to receive notifications of events (ask your Corporation leader or see our Discord server for more information)
[*] Sector highlight for placing stations and setting miner routes changed to more subtle blue color
Corporation information window now shows the level of both Corporation flagships
[*] Leap, Dispatch, Vengeance, Destiny AOE indicators will now be colored same as the color of the ship activating the module
[*] Players can now register to the Mailing list from inside the game, and filter the email types they get
Weekly events will start at a fixed time. Upcoming events are visible through the new Events browser (accessible in the Leaderboards window).  
[*] New monthly White Star event offers 5x Corporation XP for all White Stars that are discovered while the event is active. The first event will start on April 14.

[/list]

notes.title: Update notes, November 7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Additional Crystals awarded to all existing accounts, to help with the Dark Nebula transition. Check your Inbox message. Long time players will be awarded more Crystals. We recommend spending the Crystals towards economy upgrades described in the upgrade guide: http://blog.hadesstar.com/2023/10/dark-nebula-upgrade-guide.html
[*] Added additional free planet upgrades for certain accounts that were created pre-Dark Nebula
[*] Reduce build price for Battleship level 4 and over
[*] Shipment drone: Maximum capacity increased
[*] Shipment relay: Hydrogen prices decreased for Relay level 6 and lower
[*] Starter pack 2 shipment bonus increased slightly 
[*] Red Star level 11 Hydrogen costs decreased (scan & transport jump)
[*] Active modules are disabled after jump to White Star
[*] Cargo Repair in White Stars will no longer consume Relics that are still loading.
[*] Reduced requirements for Red Hydrogen achievement
[/list]

notes.title: Hades' Star 2020.3 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33944744/03d5b079d5f63ec26bf475f500908b787386af61.jpg[/img]

A major update has been deployed to the game. Summary of changes: 

• Blue Star and White Star changes, and new reworked Blue Star Leaderboards
• New module: RELIC DRONE
• New Flagship modules: DART TURRET and FLOATING SHIELD
• Module balancing
• User interface improvements

For a detailed list of changes, see the blog post: [url=http://blog.hadesstar.com/2020/10/20203-release-notes.html]http://blog.hadesstar.com/2020/10/20203-release-notes.html[/url]

notes.title: Hades' Star 2020.2 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33944744/dfecdfe64afa0a8e06b659c2eb55bb5fbee045b3.jpg[/img]

A major update has been deployed to the game. Summary of changes: 

• Red Star Level 11, comes with a new Cerberus enemy and support module.
• Credit Asteroids permanently increase daily Credit income - find them once per day on every Red Star level 2 and higher. 
• Other bug fixes, improvements and module balancing.

For a detailed list of changes, see the blog post: [url=http://blog.hadesstar.com/2020/05/20202-release-notes.html]http://blog.hadesstar.com/2020/05/20202-release-notes.html[/url]

notes.title: Hades' Star 2020.1 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33944744/4a295489e34dc8e6fa8c449d000f6478a905a4b5.jpg[/img]

A major update has been deployed to the game. Summary of changes: 

• Build and upgrade your Corporation Flagship, and strategically pick what White Star battles to take it to.
• Time Machine improvements.
• Ability to instantly re-link all Warp Lane hubs to their previous connections.
• Transports can now be ordered to start moving only after all their Artifacts are done loading.
• Bug fixes and improvements.

For a detailed list of changes, see the blog post: [url=http://blog.hadesstar.com/2019/12/20201-release-notes.html]http://blog.hadesstar.com/2019/12/20201-release-notes.html[/url]

notes.title: Supergiant games brings a new major update to Hades
notes.content:
Supergiant Games' early access roguelike Hades has had its next major update, which includes a final battle at the Gateway to the Underworld.

The BIG BAD update went live yesterday, and the patch notes show there's loads of new content to keep fans busy, as well as a bunch of bug fixes, of course.

Some of the update's highlights include a brand new biome - the Temple of Styx at the very edge of the Underworld, a Final Battle that may let Zagreus escape at last, and some brand new enemy types to face on your journey.

Read more
